productRepository: resolved from the current T3 Code checkout

laneSemantics.lane: A named work stream that may contain multiple issues.
laneSemantics.workItem: The delivery state and proof for exactly one issue.
laneSemantics.membership: Every work item names exactly one laneId; an issue cannot appear in two work items.

evidencePolicy.userVisible: Exact-base before image and annotated video plus exact-head after image and annotated video.
evidencePolicy.appearance: A visual appearance change also needs light and dark screenshots in both phases.
evidencePolicy.exception: Only non-user-visible work may omit media, with a specific reason reviewed by the evidence reviewer.
evidencePolicy.publication: No Test or phone generation plan is valid until every capture has an agent review and the proof and inspection hashes match the work item.
